title: coelogyne lurida
intro: Coelogyne lurida, commonly known as the Yellow Coelogyne, is a species of orchid native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant is known for its yellow flowers and is often used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Coelogyne lurida include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Coelogyne lurida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
